bio: Vamp Vboober and big weeb with an even bigger heart. Mostly stream whatever I'm doing with my friends, but things you can expect from me are: indie games, boomer shooters, 'friendslop', and Marvel Rivals. Hope you stick around for the chill vibes and maybe get a laugh or two from my groups antics.
